items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: Luke Skiro was doubling clarinet and tenor you see

ctx.x: he was playing sousaphone but one of the few sousaphone players around that still you know does much with him I don't think he plays it now but he was playing it with with Buck and it sounded good they had the halfway house sound they'd have an alto and Luke that's Roland Leach and Luke Skiro was doubling clarinet and tenor you see
